title: WARDOGS // ARTILLERY CALCULATOR
rangeHint: The circles show the minimum and maximum range of the selected weapon from the artillery position.
controlsHint: LMB — place point · Drag markers — move points · Ctrl+LMB / RMB — pan map · Scroll — zoom · 1 — Artillery · 2 — Target.
mapLocked: Preset map selected — grid size is locked
localAssetWarningBody: This local copy cannot use the official map CDN. Host your own permitted assets and update the configured asset URLs.
assetAccessRetryHint: Retry loading the map and terrain data.
assetAccessVerificationHint: Complete the check below to continue loading.
assetAccessLoadingHint: Please wait. You can continue using the calculator.
mapToolZoneHint: Drag from the center to set the radius.
mapToolPolygonHint: Click to add vertices. Click the first point, double-click, or press Enter to finish.
mapToolDataTransferHint: Back up or share drawings, user markers, and layer settings.
savedTargetsImportInvalid: Could not import targets from this file.
sphHullDirectionHelp: How to get the hull direction: sit in the SPH-2 driver seat (NOT the gunner seat). Do not use free camera. Read the azimuth from the compass at the top of the screen — that is the hull direction.
sphHullCorrectionInactive: Hull correction is off. Enter the hull direction to enable it.
sphHullCorrectionActive: Hull correction active: {pitch}° baseline pitch. Intended for level / near-level placements.
lockPositionHint: Lock this position against map clicks and dragging
unlockPositionHint: Allow this position to be changed on the map
fireAdjustmentPickHint: Click or tap where the round landed
fireAdjustmentHint: Add / Drop moves the target along the artillery–target line, Left / Right across it, as seen from the artillery. Marking or pasting the impact point shifts the target by the observed miss.
footerDisclaimer: Unofficial community project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by BULKHEAD or the WARDOGS development team.
lobbyPrivacy: Drawings and map markers are shared. Gun, target and weapon stay personal. Teammates see labelled points without range circles.
lobbyStatusIdle: No connection until you create or join a lobby.
lobbyStatusOffline: Disconnected. Editing paused; reconnect manually or leave.
lobbyStatusFailed: Cannot connect: the lobby may be full, expired or disabled. Check the invite and server settings.
lobbyStatusConflict: Conflicting change was not applied. Latest room state restored; your version is available as a recovery copy.
lobbyStatusQuota: Change limit reached. Editing paused. Export the room before leaving.
lobbyStatusInvalid: Room limits exceeded or unsupported data. Your version is available as a recovery copy.
lobbyCloseConfirm: Close this lobby for everyone and delete its shared state?
lobbyLeaveConfirm: Some changes are not confirmed by the server. Leave anyway? A recovery copy will remain available until reload.
lobbyReconnectConfirm: Reconnect and load the server version? Unconfirmed changes will be kept as a recovery copy.
lobbyStatusClosed: Lobby closed or expired. Your personal workspace has been restored.
lobbyMapFixed: Room map is fixed. Leave to change it.
lobbyStatusBudget: Daily room creation limit reached. Try after 00:00 UTC.
lobbyStatusLimited: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
lobbyStatusChallenge: Complete the security check, then press Create lobby again.
lobbyStatusSecurity: Lobby creation security is unavailable or not configured.
lobbyStatusAdmissionLimit: This security session reached its room limit. Complete a new check.
lobbyRecoveryAvailable: A recovery copy is available below. It is kept only in this tab until reload.
supportStatementGrowth: As WARDOGS Artillery Calculator continues to grow and more people use it, **the cost of keeping the project running is increasing as well.**
supportStatementFree: This project was never intended to be commercial. **I do not plan to introduce third-party advertising, paid features, premium tiers, or subscriptions.** The project will remain free, and its funding model will continue to be based on voluntary support from its users.
supportStatementInvite: If you find the project useful and would like to help cover its running costs, **you can support it with a voluntary donation.**
supportStatementCosts: Donations are used to pay for **the domain, Umami analytics, Cloudflare services, asset hosting, and other infrastructure required to keep the project running smoothly.**
supportStatementContinuity: **Development will continue regardless of whether the project receives financial support.** However, without donations I may need to significantly reduce spending on analytics and asset hosting. This would mean making compromises that could affect **performance, reliability, the user experience, and the speed at which updates and improvements can be delivered.**
supportStatementPayments: Payments are handled by third-party payment providers. If you are unable to make a payment or have any other questions, please contact me at:
experimentalTerrainCorrectionNote: Terrain3D correction is automatic. Beyond the verified height range, results are model estimates. Platform/chassis tilt is not inferred from the terrain.
experimentalTerrainCorrectionUnavailable: Terrain3D correction is unavailable for this firing solution.
experimentalTerrainCorrectionUnsupported: No certified Terrain3D candidate for this arc.
sphLevelWarningBody: Vehicle tilt changes the actual range. Park the SPH-2 on the flattest ground available. In the gunner HUD, find the vehicle silhouette below STABILIZED / ASL: the two small side markers show lateral tilt. Reposition the vehicle until the markers are as centered and aligned as possible. Front/back slope also affects range, so avoid parking uphill or downhill.
solutionSupportPrompt: Useful? Help keep the project online
developerCaptureHint: Capture before firing. Position and calculator commands stay fixed until you capture a new series.
developerActualHint: Enter what you actually set in the game. Empty fields are reported as unknown.
developerImpacts: Impacts: one x, y pair per line
developerCopyManual: Clipboard unavailable. Select the text below and copy it manually.
developerInvalidShotData: Check the numeric fields and shot count.
developerInvalidImpacts: Use one x, y pair per line, with decimal points. Up to 100 impacts.
developerFiringUnavailable: Wait for the calculator and select a weapon.
developerSeriesChanged: The current map, position, weapon, hull or arc differs from the captured series. The report still uses the captured values.
developerPrivacy: Diagnostics are copied locally. Cookies, tokens and lobby invitation links are excluded.
developerClearSeries: Copy your report, then clear the recorded fields before capturing another series.
developerLoginHint: Use your private developer key. It is sent to the gateway once and is not stored in the browser.
developerAccessDenied: Access denied. Check your key and allowed IP addresses.
developerAccessUnavailable: Developer access is unavailable. Check the gateway and security rules.
experimentalTerrainCorrectionModelUnreac: No trajectory found by the Terrain3D model
reloadTrainerReady: Press R to start a circle.
reloadTrainerPlaying: Enter the arrows in order, or wait for the section to fill.
reloadTrainerFailed: Wrong key — the whole circle restarts.
reloadTrainerComplete: Circle complete. Press R for the next one.
reloadTrainerInterrupted: Attempt stopped. Press R to start again.
reloadTrainerHint: Each section fills in 6.5 seconds. Enter its four WASD arrows to finish it sooner. A wrong key resets the entire circle and your streak.
reloadTrainerKeyboardHint: R — start / restart · Esc — close. Map keyboard controls are suspended while training.
